scenarios.title: Register an attendee without specifying an ID
given: qr code generation succeeds for both the png image file and data url
scenarios.when: an attendee registration request is sent for the event without specifying an id
then: the client receives a successful registration response containing an assigned attendee id (e.g. 101)
the response contains a target url pointing to the assigned attendee id (e.g. https://<host>/101)
the response contains an image source url with the lowercased event name and attendee id (e.g. https://<host>/techconf/101.png)
the response contains the generated qr code data url

scenarios.title: Register an attendee with a manual numeric ID
given: a manual numeric id is specified (e.g. 456)
qr code generation succeeds for both the png image file and data url
scenarios.when: an attendee registration request is sent for the event with the manual numeric id
then: the client receives a successful registration response containing the requested attendee id (e.g. 456)
the response contains a target url pointing to the requested attendee id (e.g. https://<host>/456)
the response contains an image source url with the lowercased event name and requested attendee id (e.g. https://<host>/techconf/456.png)
the response contains the generated qr code data url

scenarios.title: Register an attendee when the ID route segment is non-numeric
given: a non-numeric id segment is provided in the registration path (e.g. vip)
qr code generation succeeds for both the png image file and data url
scenarios.when: an attendee registration request is sent with the non-numeric id segment
then: the client receives a successful registration response containing a system-assigned attendee id rather than the non-numeric value
the response contains a target url pointing to the system-assigned attendee id
the response contains an image source url with the lowercased event name and system-assigned attendee id
the response contains the generated qr code data url

scenarios.title: Registration fails when database identity creation produces no recordset
given: the database does not return a valid identity recordset
scenarios.when: an attendee registration request is sent
then: an error page displaying the message "Invalid ID." is returned to the client
no registration json payload is returned

scenarios.title: Registration fails when QR PNG file creation encounters an error
given: an event exists and identity creation succeeds in the database
qr png file creation fails with an error
scenarios.when: an attendee registration request is sent
then: an error page displaying the message "Couldn't create .png file." is returned to the client
no registration json payload is returned

scenarios.title: Registration fails when QR data URL creation encounters an error
given: an event exists and identity creation succeeds in the database
qr data url creation fails with an error
scenarios.when: an attendee registration request is sent
then: an error page displaying the message "Couldn't create the data blob." is returned to the client
no registration json payload is returned
